compute_tapvid_metrics: compute TAP-Vid metrics including Jaccard, points within threshold, and occlusion accuracy for video tracking predictions
run_compute_tapvid_metrics: run compute_tapvid_metrics with query points, ground truth occlusions, and predicted tracks to evaluate tracking performance
test_compute_tapvid_metrics: test compute_tapvid_metrics by passing numpy arrays for query points, ground truth, and predictions in first or strided mode
review_compute_tapvid_metrics: review compute_tapvid_metrics to understand how Jaccard and occlusion accuracy are computed across pixel thresholds
refactor_compute_tapvid_metrics: refactor compute_tapvid_metrics to support additional query modes beyond first and strided sampling strategies
